title: From scarcity into famine
literal_meaning: To go from high prices into famine.
explanation: A change meant to escape difficulty leads into something worse. Here କାନ୍ତାର is the dictionary’s famine sense, not its separate forest sense.
meaning_odia: ଗୋଟିଏ ଅସୁବିଧାରୁ ମୁକୁଳିବାକୁ ଯାଇ ଆହୁରି ବଡ଼ ଅସୁବିଧାରେ ପଡ଼ିବା। ଏଠାରେ କାନ୍ତାରର ଅର୍ଥ ଦୁର୍ଭିକ୍ଷ।
usage_example: A shop changes to a cheaper supplier, then loses more because deliveries repeatedly fail. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The food-scarcity image supplies the comparison; no particular famine or historical event is identified.

witnesses.locator: ଦେ. ବି., sense1 famine; explicit ଢଗ
